The following database demonstrates the implementation of modular sorting. It lets you sort by module, either in Selection mode or in Entity Selection mode. Since the dialog is independent, it lets you view the sorting in real time.
To use the database, click the button corresponding to the selection mode you want. In the interface, then click the Sort button to open the dialog and start using the various features.
